title: Understanding L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, tends to produce sparse models by driving some coefficients to zero. This means it selects only the most important features.

title: Effect of L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.

title: Choosing the Optimal Parameter
text: The optimal parameter with L1 regularization is often the one that results in the simplest model with the least number of non-zero coefficients while still fitting the data well.
